answer_1.quote: we introduce VisText: a benchmark dataset of 12,441 pairs of charts and captions.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate each model using machine translation and text generation metrics, including BLEU, Perplexity, Relation Generation (RG), ROUGE, Word Mover's Distance (WMD), and Translational Error Rate (TER).

answer_4.quote: we qualitatively assess the descriptiveness and accuracy of the generated chart captions... iteratively analyzing captions in a "bottom-up" fashion to identify emergent patterns in how generated captions compare to the ground truth.
